context:
Treat this as a release-quality evidence gate, not a prose summary. The output
must let a reviewer trace each PR #246 finding from before screenshot, through
remediation TODO, to after screenshot and verification result.
description:
PR #246 created the baseline evidence for Results Explorer visual hierarchy,
usability, and data-presentation quality. After the route-specific remediation
items are implemented, the team needs a final evidence gate that proves the
same route and viewport matrix no longer exhibits the captured issues.

This TODO owns the closeout pass. It should rerun the PR #246 methodology,
recapture the full screenshot matrix, compare before/after evidence by
finding ID, and ensure any residual Major issue has either been fixed or has a
concrete follow-up TODO before release readiness is claimed.

anti_patterns.dont: bury residual issues in prose; every release-blocking issue needs a concrete TODO.
ignore console or network errors because the screenshot looks acceptable.
mark the Explorer ready while any PR #246 Major finding remains unowned.
recapture only desktop screenshots; mobile and tablet evidence is required.
substitute unit tests for visual and interaction QA on this evidence gate.

preserves.behavior: Browser Use or equivalent live-browser inspection remains part of manual QA.
Every public route and share URL in the PR #246 route matrix.
Final evidence is stored under `_project/audits/` and can be reviewed later.
No launch-ready verdict with visible raw internal errors or unowned Major findings.
PR #246 baseline audit and screenshots remain available as before evidence.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

verifications.expected: Chromium e2e checks pass or skipped browser reason is documented

verifications.command:
uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/todo_cli.py validate _project/TODO
uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/todo_cli.py check-graph
uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/todo_cli.py reindex
verifications.description: TODO graph and indexes are valid
verifications.expected: TODO validation, graph check, and reindex all succeed

verifications.command: echo 'Manual: compare all PR #246 baseline screenshots against final recaptures and record finding closure table'
verifications.description: Manual PR #246 final evidence matrix is complete
verifications.expected: final closeout report exists and owns every residual issue
